authority.entry_board: 57048 VALID1061; root direct af55d2 PASS, journal1070

implemented: Shared bounded opaque nonce and representable integer time validation; SDK mints a compatible Host token plus guarded nonwrapping core-local sequence once per ready/tracking-approved envelope. Invalid sources return nonthrowing send failure.

The action route preserves supplied eventId and zero timestamp, rejects malformed explicit nonce/time before processing, and mints request fallback only after resolved tracking consent. One outcome record, including logical nonce/source and old lookup prefix, is sent to queue and learning.

Content service supplies a consent-gated request nonce to pure decideContent; no scoring/exploration input changed. Decision records and replay preserve and compare exact request_id/decision_id, including strict malformed/absent distinction and legitimate old page/slot delimiters.

Three grouped additions in the admitted existing fixtures; one existing SDK field-list expectation adapted. Two existing SDK bundles regenerated by the existing script and byte-checked against in-memory builds; scoped API contract updated.

failures_and_superseding_validation.cause: New unready direct-envelope assertion exposed nonce minting with trackingAllowed alone, which did not establish readiness.
failures_and_superseding_validation.correction: Nonce mint now also requires isCurrent(generation); no legacy attribution behavior changed.

failures_and_superseding_validation.cause: Generic pre-ready Host.uuid spy also counted the existing browsing-session mint, despite no eventId being emitted.
failures_and_superseding_validation.correction: Isolate logical identity by absent eventId and first post-ready sequence1; retain actual tracking-refused no-mint spy. Also make pure replay fixture piece eligible for its test slot and assert one record, as requested by root.

limitations: Collision-resistant logical identity only, not sink idempotency, exactly-once counters, safe automatic retries, payload-conflict detection, business-order uniqueness, aggregate seen-marker lifecycle, W09/W22/F16 closure or release/customer/deployed acceptance.

Same event identity requires the original immutable nonce, timestamp, subject and scope. Fresh SDK send/service request is a new event/request; legacy route request fallback cannot correlate repeated HTTP requests. Existing SDK Host fallbacks are not guaranteed cryptographic/global uniqueness.
Legacy no-nonce helper/stored IDs remain; legacy route absent/zero timestamp uses server time. Explicit invalid timestamp is now refused before effects. No future/skew policy introduced.

Existing learning destination spies prove nonce propagation, not sink persistence; their legacy/missing receipt bindings correctly report learning_incomplete. Accepted protected sink arithmetic/acknowledgement and erasure/read-prefix assurance reused.

Only fixed15 selected runtime checks;81 other cases intentionally unselected across the five fixtures. No broader suites, extra infrastructure, persistent seen state, deployments, customer operations, commits or external calls.

SDK sequence exhaustion guard is source-confirmed; runtime did not perform Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER sends. Existing direct unready envelope may still mint legacy browsing-session attribution, but not a logical event nonce.
capture_notes: All required execution captures are retained below, including both failing candidates. Silent successful compiler/whitespace inferred only from the completed sequential && compound, not separately invoked passes.

Initial attempted baseline-lint read used evidence/W09.05 instead of design/W09.05 and returned ENOENT (read-only); corrected to actual admitted design/baseline-lint.json and read it completely. This was not a runtime or baseline rerun.

compiler.basis: First component of exact completed sequential && compound; no separate invocation claimed.

lint.comparison: Same inherited file/rule/message diagnostics; source insertions shift line numbers only.

whitespace.basis: Last component of exact completed sequential && compound.
